design_rationale:
[Why a good test] Renata asks only to close her payout account today "with whatever money is in it sent out". On her Everyday Pay Card Platinum account the closure waits on three problems she never names: the final card load is fixed only after the account carries an instant cashout dated the closing day; a card-plan account is not closed until the closing cashback settlement (2026-09, payment day 2026-10-05 not yet come) is paid; and that settlement is fixed only after the payments cover all cashback earned in months whose payment day has passed (2026-08 passed 2026-09-05 without a payment; the ledger does not say why). Each write is a multi-factor figure built from the cashback and payout ledgers, the shopper's level/points/ratings/activation (shopper difficulty), batch history (batch difficulty) and her Cartwise+ Premier membership (membership difficulty). Two of the four writes are the shopper's own.

[Scope] Task 0 occupies card_plan_exit, returned_resend, sweep_catchup, debit_cashout. Task 1 claims payout_ext_statement_cashback (pay_statement_cashback_5d281cc6), payout_ext_closing_cashback (settle_closing_cashback_4e373fbf), payout_ext_card_cashout (cash_out_to_card_075a5c73, user), payout_ext_closure_disbursement (close_payout_account_ca79a9a7, user). Together the two tasks cover all 8 policies with disjoint scopes.

[Draw] draw_counts.py --task 1: {"prerequisite_problems": 3, "factor_counts": [5, 5, 6, 4]} -> statement 5, card cashout 5, closure 6, closing 4.

[Problem-tree card] Root payout_ext_closure_disbursement.
 E1 closure <- card_cashout, value_input, gate bal, STATE form: "On a card plan, the final card load is fixed only after the account carries an instant cashout dated the day of closing." On an account whose plan on record is an Everyday Pay Card plan only the card cashout books an instant cashout (the debit cashout is worked out only on Instant Cashout). Seed false: no cashout dated 2026-10-03; balance 177.85. Skip run: 134.30 instead of 53.05.
 E2 closure <- closing_cashback, state_gate, gate payout_accounts.cashback_balance_usd, ACTION form (negated): "A card-plan account is not closed until the closing cashback settlement has been paid onto the card." fallback_reason: the settlement books the same cashback-payment entry kind as a statement payment. Seed false: 2026-09 carries no payment; cashback balance 125.00. Skip: the 66.15 payment is missing and September lapses.
 E3 closing <- statement, value_input, gate payments_3m, ACTION form: "The closing cashback settlement is fixed only after the statement payment owed for the months whose payment day has passed, where one is owed, has been made." fallback_reason: a payment leaves only an ordinary cashback payment entry, and whether one is owed depends on the balance and the minimum payment, so every record-visible state is unreachable in some world (nothing owed, or a capped payment leaving part for the next payment day). Seed false: 71.40 due for 2026-08 (balance 125.00 less the waiting 53.60), no payment since 2026-08-05. Skip run: 33.08 instead of 66.15.
 Order: statement -> closing -> card cashout -> closure; the card cashout commutes with the cashback chain (replayed: identical terminal DB). No real-world wait; persona names no prerequisite; tools validate none.

[Factor card - statement 82.75, baseline 60.00] member booster (parameter, cross membership) x1.1 (78.97); statement cap by level (parameter, cross batch, multi-source: Platinum AND 23 base pays) 1.25 x 60.00 = 75.00 (67.00); late make-good (method: 59 days since the last payment, Platinum -> 5 percent of the capped figure, not the fixed 2.00) 3.75 (79.00); tenure kicker (parameter, cross shopper) 2.50 (80.25); long-haul credit (parameter, cross batch: 3 entries) 1.50 (81.25). [Factor card - card cashout 81.25, baseline 168.85] tip release (parameter, cross batch, multi-source) all 9.00 released (72.25); clawback reserve (parameter, cross batch) 30.00 (111.25); conduct reserve (parameter, cross shopper) 15.00 (96.25); card debit buffer (method: 2 debits in 3 months -> the largest earnings debit ever booked, 26.60, not the fixed 10.00) (107.85); new-level reserve (parameter, cross shopper) 25.00 (106.25).

The base "agent registers, shopper confirms" clause is overridden by the shopper's one-step closure.

(completed 2026-10-03, accepted 07:05, credits 33.30, tip 9.00); debits answer the duplicate-pay reversals of the 2026-07-20 and 2026-09-14 batches.

[Standard solution] verify; read account, ledger, contractor account and events, batches, batch entries, membership; statement payment 82.75 for 2026-08; closing settlement 66.15 for 2026-09; hand over the card cashout 81.25; hand over the closure with 53.05.
[Verification code] scratchpad evalc.py/run_both.py: statement 82.75 base 60.00; closing 66.15 base 26.80; card cashout 81.25 base 168.85; closure 53.05 base 63.30; skips statement->closing 33.08, cashout->closure 134.30; alternative order identical terminal DB. check_compute --task 1: COMPUTE OK.
[Closure] statement -> pay_statement_cashback_5d281cc6 -> step 10 amount_usd 82.75; closing -> settle_closing_cashback_4e373fbf -> step 12 amount_usd 66.15; card cashout -> cash_out_to_card_075a5c73 -> step 14 amount_usd 81.25; closure -> close_payout_account_ca79a9a7 -> step 16 final_disbursement_usd 53.05.
[Most likely errors] paying September with the statement payment; settling before the August payment (share 0.5); counting EV once; a fixed debit buffer; a fixed clawback reserve; not halving the closing reserves; closing without the cashout.
[Revisions] Round 1: card cashout request binding cites "sent out to you". Round 2 (audit F-C1..F-C10): scalar methods relabelled parameter, genuine methods added (thank-you 5 percent vs fixed, card debit buffer largest debit vs fixed, closing clawback largest reversal vs fixed); statement cap as a multiple of the plan cap (F-C4); closing sentence first changed to an amount test (F-C3); closure<-card cashout now state form without the "cashable balance" phrase (F-C7); closure<-closing gate is the cashback balance field (F-C6); card-cashout level-evaluation fall-back stated (F-C5); unfinalized batch accepted 07:05 before the call; the unrecorded fraud-review claim removed; persona hand-over line made neutral. New figures 66.15 / 81.25 / 53.05 propagated.

[Revisions round 3] F-R2-1: the amount test could be made unreachable by the statement cap (e.g. 132.50 < 136.90 under the plan-cap tier); the closing sentence now waits on "the latest statement month whose payment day has passed carries a cashback payment", and the statement rule carries the latest such month and states that the capped-off excess lapses, so one statement payment always satisfies the state (gold path unchanged: 2026-08 carried by the 82.75 payment). Seed clock: finalized batch 5cbab988 (completed 2026-10-02) now accepted 08:05, so its 24-hour finalization falls before the 11:05 call. F-C6 gate: payout_accounts.cashback_balance_usd kept as the <table>.<field> gate form the skill allows for state_gate (the closure declares no eligibility of its own); no value consequence.

[Revisions round 4] F-R3-1: the statement lapse clause is gone; the cashback still to be paid is defined once as the card cashback balance (raised by earnings, lowered by every payment including bonuses, cleared at a lapse, never below zero, never above earned less paid), read by the statement payment and the exit settlement alike, so a capped-off excess carries to the next payment day. Checked against every rule reading unpaid cashback: statement (due from that balance, minimum-payment test added), exit (older part from that balance), closing (latest waiting month only, which the statement never pays), closure and exit tools (clear the balance). Because a capped payment can now leave part due for a later payment day and a small due amount owes no payment, any state-form wording of E3 is unreachable in some world, so E3 is now action form with its fallback reason; one statement payment, or none when nothing is owed, always resolves it. Gold unchanged (82.75 / 66.15 / 81.25 / 53.05).

edges.condition: The account, while its plan on record is an Everyday Pay Card plan, carries a payout_instant_cashout row dated the day of closing.
edges.policy_source: On a card plan, the final card load is fixed only after the account carries an instant cashout dated the day of closing.

unresolved_at_frozen_time.why_false: No instant cashout is booked on the account on 2026-10-03 while its plan on record is Everyday Pay Card Platinum; the balance of 177.85 is still on the account.
unresolved_at_frozen_time.flips_to_true_by: The shopper's card cashout books a payout_instant_cashout of 81.25 dated 2026-10-03; the closure's balance binding falls from 177.85 to 96.60.

edges.condition: The latest statement month with payout_cashback_earned rows carries a payout_cashback_paid row, so the card cashback balance shown on the account no longer holds that month's cashback.
edges.policy_source: A card-plan account is not closed until the closing cashback settlement has been paid onto the card.

unresolved_at_frozen_time.why_false: The latest month with earned cashback, 2026-09 (entries booked 2026-10-01), carries no cashback payment, and its payment day 2026-10-05 has not come.
unresolved_at_frozen_time.flips_to_true_by: The closing settlement books a payout_cashback_paid of 66.15 carrying 2026-09 and the card cashback balance falls to 0.00; the closure may then be recorded.

edges.fallback_reason: The closing settlement books an ordinary cashback payment entry for its statement month, the same entry kind a statement payment books, so no record-visible state tells the closing settlement apart from a statement payment; only the action can be named.

edges.condition: Where the card cashback balance less the latest waiting month's earned cashback is at least the card plan's minimum cashback payment, a payout_cashback_paid row carrying the latest month whose payment day has passed has been booked.
edges.policy_source: The closing cashback settlement is fixed only after the statement payment owed for the months whose payment day has passed, where one is owed, has been made.

unresolved_at_frozen_time.why_false: A statement payment is owed and not made: 2026-08 passed its payment day 2026-09-05; the card cashback balance 125.00 less the waiting 2026-09 month 53.60 leaves 71.40 due, above the 1.00 minimum, and no cashback payment has been booked since 2026-07's on 2026-08-05.
unresolved_at_frozen_time.flips_to_true_by: The statement payment of 82.75 carrying 2026-08 is made; the closing settlement's count of cashback payments in the last 3 months rises from 2 to 3 and its share from 0.5 to 1.0.

edges.fallback_reason: A statement payment leaves only an ordinary cashback payment entry carrying a month, and whether one is owed at all depends on the card cashback balance and the minimum payment (an amount below it, or a balance already lowered by earlier bonuses, owes no payment); a record-visible state such as 'the latest passed month carries a payment' is then unreachable when nothing is owed, and an amount state is unreachable when a capped payment leaves part in the balance for the next payment day, so only the action can be named.

prerequisite_closure.order_uniqueness: The card cashout is parallel to the chain statement payment -> closing settlement. The cashout writes only an instant cashout, its 0.00 fee entry and the unpaid earnings balance; the two cashback computations read only cashback entries, which the cashout does not touch, and the cashout's computation reads no cashback entry. Replaying cashout -> statement -> closing -> closure gives the same values (81.25, 82.75, 66.15, 53.05) and an identical terminal DB (scratchpad run_t1.py 'alt order ... True'). The statement payment precedes the closing settlement by the sentence 'The closing cashback settlement is fixed only after the statement payment owed for the months whose payment day has passed, where one is owed, has been made.'; the cashout and the closing settlement precede the closure by its two sentences.

edge_load_bearing.skipped_effect: Skipping the card cashout leaves the balance at 177.85: the final disbursement becomes 134.30 instead of 53.05 and no instant cashout entry exists.

Skipping the closing settlement leaves 2026-09 without a payment: the terminal DB lacks the 66.15 cashback payment and the September cashback lapses with the closure (state_gate; the disbursement figure itself stays 53.05).

Skipping the statement payment leaves 2 cashback payments in the last 3 months: the closing share falls to 0.5 and the closing settlement becomes 33.08 instead of 66.15; the 2026-08 payment is missing.

prerequisite_closure.no_user_hint: user_scenario asks only to close the payout account and have her money sent out. It never mentions a cashout, cashback, a statement month or any step to do first; it reacts to those only after the agent explains them.
prerequisite_closure.tools_do_not_block: In task_tools.py close_payout_account_ca79a9a7 records the request, closes the account and books the final disbursement whatever the balance, cashouts or cashback payments; settle_closing_cashback_4e373fbf books its payment whether or not earlier months are paid; neither reads a prerequisite state, raises an error or hints.

user_scenario:
You are Renata Voss, 39, who has shopped for Cartwise in Denver for five years and starts a salaried warehouse-planning job on Monday. You are calm, organised and a bit formal, and you like to hear a step explained before you agree to it. You call on a Saturday morning to say you are stopping shopping and want to close your Cartwise payout account today, with whatever money is in it sent out to you. That is the whole of your request; you do not know the payout rules, you do not know what your balance or any cashback figure is, and you do not bring up any other topic.

When the agent needs to find you, you give your mobile number, 7205556621. When asked to confirm your identity you give your date of birth, 1987-02-23; if a different detail is wanted, your email is renata.voss@netcourier.com and your home ZIP code is 80206. If the agent asks where your pay goes, you say it goes to your Cartwise Everyday Pay Card ending in 9154, which you are keeping in your wallet. If you are asked whether you are sure about closing, you say yes, you are not coming back to shopping.

You let the agent take care of anything on the account that has to be settled for you, and whenever the agent explains that something needs doing first you say that makes sense and to go ahead. Some steps are yours to do: whenever the agent hands you a step to carry out yourself, you do it with exactly the account number and amount the agent gives you, and when the agent hands you the closing of the account with the final amount, you close it with exactly the account number and amount the agent gives you. You take the agent's figures as given and never propose numbers of your own. Once the closing goes through you thank the agent, say goodbye and end the call without asking for anything else.
